articles.title: 解析驱动慢性疼痛的脊髓-脑-脊髓回路
articles.originalTitle: Deconstruction of a spino-brain-spinal cord circuit that drives chronic pain.
articles.abstract: Tissue inflammation or nerve injury at the periphery can cause chronic pain. Although the spinal-cord-projecting neurons in the rostral ventromedial medulla (RVM(SC) neurons) can promote pain chronification(1-4), the pathway by which peripheral injury signals drive these neurons is poorly understood(1-3,5). Here we report a circuit loop that extends from the spinal cord to the ventral posterolateral thalamus and posterior complex of the thalamus, proceeds to the primary somatosensory cortex and returns to the spinal cord via the lateral superior colliculus, which in turn connects to mu-opioid-receptor-expressing RVM(SC) neurons. Silencing any node along this multisynaptic circuit has minimal effects on nociception in healthy mice, but can eliminate mechanical hypersensitization and restore normal nociceptive response thresholds in mouse models of inflammatory and neuropathic pain. In healthy mice, repetitive-but not acute-activation of each node in this circuit is sufficient to cause robust chronic mechanical hypersensitization. Our findings reveal a spino-brain-spinal cord circuit loop that links ascending and descending pathways and specifically drives chronic mechanical pain. This could enable the identification of cellular targets for treating chronic pain.

sections.text: 外周组织炎症或神经损伤可引起慢性疼痛。尽管延髓头端腹内侧区（RVM(SC)神经元）中投射到脊髓的神经元可促进疼痛慢性化(1-4)，但外周损伤信号驱动这些神经元的通路尚不清楚(1-3,5)。在此，我们报告了一个从脊髓延伸到丘脑腹后外侧核和丘脑后复合体，再传递到初级躯体感觉皮层，并通过外侧上丘返回脊髓的回路环，该回路环进而连接到表达μ-阿片受体的RVM(SC)神经元。沉默这一多突触回路上的任何节点，对健康小鼠的伤害感受影响极小，但在炎症性和神经病理性疼痛小鼠模型中，可消除机械性超敏反应并恢复正常的伤害性反应阈值。在健康小鼠中，重复激活（而非急性激活）该回路的每个节点足以引起强烈的慢性机械性超敏反应。我们的发现揭示了一个连接上行和下行通路的脊髓-脑-脊髓回路环，该回路环特异性地驱动慢性机械性疼痛。这可能有助于确定治疗慢性疼痛的细胞靶点。

articles.title: 老年患者术后谵妄的预测与风险评估：来自前瞻性BioCog队列研究的算法开发与内部验证
articles.originalTitle: Prediction and risk evaluation of delirium after surgery in older patients: development and internal validation of an algorithm from the prospective BioCog cohort study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Postoperative delirium (POD) affects  approximately 20% of older surgical patients. It is associated with poor clinical outcome and increased mortality. We aimed to identify the major POD risk factors and to develop and validate a multivariate algorithm for individual POD risk prediction and risk evaluation in the very early postoperative period. METHODS: BioCog is a prospective cohort study conducted in the anaesthesiology departments of two tertiary care centres in Germany and The Netherlands. Patients aged >/=65 yr with no preoperative dementia (Mini-Mental Status Examination >/=24) undergoing surgery with an expected duration of at least 60 min were enrolled and screened for POD according to DSM 5 until the seventh postoperative day. Clinical, neuropsychological, neuroimaging data, and blood were measured before and after surgery. We evaluated several models by sequentially adding blocks of variables. Gradient-boosted trees (GBT) with nested cross-validation were used for POD prediction. Model accuracy (area under the receiver-operating curve, AUC) and calibration were assessed (Brier score). RESULTS: Out of 929 patients, 184 (20%) experienced POD. A GBT algorithm using both preoperative data, characteristics of the intervention, and postoperative changes in laboratory parameters achieved the highest AUC (0.83, [0.79-0.86]) with a Brier score of 0.12 (0.12-0.13). CONCLUSIONS: Models combining preoperative with precipitating factors during surgery predict POD with high accuracy. This suggests that the resulting algorithms eventually may become useful to support clinical decision-making. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: NCT02265263.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 术后谵妄（POD）影响约20%的老年手术患者。它与不良临床结局和死亡率增加相关。我们旨在识别主要的POD风险因素，并开发和验证一个多变量算法，用于术后极早期的个体化POD风险预测和风险评估。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: BioCog是一项在德国和荷兰两个三级医疗中心的麻醉科进行的前瞻性队列研究。纳入年龄≥65岁、无术前痴呆（简易精神状态检查≥24）、预期手术时间至少60分钟的患者，并根据DSM-5标准筛查POD直至术后第七天。在手术前后测量临床、神经心理学、神经影像学数据和血液指标。我们通过依次添加变量块来评估多个模型。使用梯度提升树（GBT）和嵌套交叉验证进行POD预测。评估模型准确性（受试者工作特征曲线下面积，AUC）和校准（Brier评分）。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在929名患者中，184名（20%）出现POD。使用术前数据、干预特征和术后实验室参数变化的GBT算法达到了最高的AUC（0.83，[0.79-0.86]），Brier评分为0.12（0.12-0.13）。

sections.text: 结合术前因素和术中诱发因素的模型能够高精度地预测POD。这表明最终生成的算法可能有助于支持临床决策。

articles.title: 大型语言模型生成的围术期神经认知障碍建议与已发表指南的比较：一项横断面网络分析
articles.originalTitle: A comparison of large language model-generated and published perioperative neurocognitive disorder recommendations: a cross-sectional web-based analysis.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Perioperative neurocognitive disorders (PNDs) are common complications after surgery and anaesthesia, particularly in older adults, leading to increased morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. Therefore, major medical societies have developed recommendations for the prevention and treatment of PNDs. Our study evaluated the reliability of large language models, specifically ChatGPT-4 and Gemini, in generating recommendations for PND management and comparing them with published guidelines. METHODS: We conducted an online cross-sectional web-based analysis over 48 h in June 2024. Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated recommendations were produced in six different locations across five countries (Switzerland, Belgium, Turkey, Canada, and the East and West Coasts of the USA). The English prompt 'a table of a bundle of care for perioperative neurocognitive disorders' was entered into ChatGPT-4 and Gemini, generating tables evaluated by independent reviewers. The primary outcomes were the Total Disagreement Score (TDS) and Quality Assessment of Medical Artificial Intelligence (QAMAI), which compared AI-generated recommendations with published guidelines. RESULTS: The study generated 14 tables, with TDS and QAMAI scores showing similar results for ChatGPT-4 and Gemini (2 [1-3] vs 2 [2-3], P=0.636 and 4 [4-4] vs 4 [3-4], P=0.424, respectively). AI-generated recommendations aligned well with published guidelines, with the highest alignment observed in ChatGPT-4-generated recommendations. No complete agreement with guidelines was achieved, and lack of cited sources was a noted limitation. CONCLUSIONS: Large language models can generate perioperative neurocognitive disorder recommendations that align closely with published guidelines. However, further validation and integration of clinician feedback are required before clinical application.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 围手术期神经认知障碍（PNDs）是手术和麻醉后的常见并发症，尤其在老年人中，导致发病率、死亡率和医疗费用增加。因此，主要医学学会已制定PNDs预防和治疗的建议。我们的研究评估了大型语言模型（特别是ChatGPT-4和Gemini）在生成PND管理建议方面的可靠性，并将其与已发表的指南进行比较。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们在2024年6月进行了一项为期48小时的在线横断面网络分析。人工智能（AI）生成的建议在五个国家的六个不同地点（瑞士、比利时、土耳其、加拿大以及美国东海岸和西海岸）产生。英文提示词“a table of a bundle of care for perioperative neurocognitive disorders”被输入到ChatGPT-4和Gemini中，生成的表格由独立评审员评估。主要结局是总不一致评分（TDS）和医学人工智能质量评估（QAMAI），将AI生成的建议与已发表的指南进行比较。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 该研究生成了14个表格，ChatGPT-4和Gemini的TDS和QAMAI评分结果相似（分别为2 [1-3] vs 2 [2-3]，P=0.636；4 [4-4] vs 4 [3-4]，P=0.424）。AI生成的建议与已发表的指南高度一致，其中ChatGPT-4生成的建议一致性最高。未实现与指南的完全一致，缺乏引用来源是一个已指出的局限性。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 大型语言模型可以生成与已发表指南高度一致的围手术期神经认知障碍建议。然而，在临床应用之前，需要进一步验证并整合临床医生的反馈。

articles.title: 氯胺酮与替代药物预防危重症成人气管插管诱导后血流动力学不稳定的系统评价与Meta分析
articles.originalTitle: Ketamine versus alternate agents to prevent postinduction haemodynamic instability during tracheal intubation of critically ill adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Postinduction haemodynamic instability is common in critically ill adults undergoing emergency tracheal intubation. Ketamine is frequently used for induction of anaesthesia in patients perceived to be at high risk of haemodynamic instability; however, its haemodynamic effects relative to other induction agents remain uncertain. We sought to evaluate the effect of ketamine compared with alternative induction agents on postinduction haemodynamic instability and other clinically important outcomes during emergency tracheal intubation. METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to a prospectively registered International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews protocol (CRD42024618433) and Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analyses guidelines. Randomised controlled trials enrolling adults undergoing tracheal intubation in the emergency department or intensive care unit were included. Searches of six databases and three trial registries were performed to November 5, 2025, supplemented by pre-publication access to the RSI trial. The primary outcome was postinduction haemodynamic instability harmonised across trials. A random-effects model with Hartung-Knapp adjustment was used. RESULTS: Ten trials (n=4673) met inclusion criteria, of which nine used etomidate as the comparator, and one used a regimen of midazolam and sufentanil. There was a significantly greater risk of postinduction haemodynamic instability (risk ratio 1.28 [1.13-1.45]) with ketamine compared with etomidate. However, when compared with the alternative comparator, ketamine appeared superior (risk ratio 0.51 [0.29-0.89]). No differences in mortality, ventilator-free days, or ICU-free days were shown. CONCLUSIONS: Ketamine appears associated with less haemodynamic stability than etomidate during the peri-intubation period but might perform more favourably than other agents, with no effect on longer-term outcomes.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 诱导后血流动力学不稳定在需要紧急气管插管的危重成人中很常见。氯胺酮常用于被认为有血流动力学不稳定高风险患者的麻醉诱导；然而，与其他诱导药物相比，其血流动力学效应仍不确定。我们旨在评估氯胺酮与替代诱导药物相比对紧急气管插管期间诱导后血流动力学不稳定及其他临床重要结局的影响。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们根据前瞻性注册的国际系统评价前瞻性注册方案（CRD42024618433）和系统评价与荟萃分析优先报告条目指南进行了系统评价和荟萃分析。纳入在急诊科或重症监护室接受气管插管的成人随机对照试验。检索了六个数据库和三个试验注册库，截至2025年11月5日，并补充了RSI试验的预发表访问。主要结局是跨试验协调的诱导后血流动力学不稳定。使用随机效应模型和Hartung-Knapp调整。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 十项试验（n=4673）符合纳入标准，其中九项以依托咪酯作为对照，一项使用咪达唑仑和舒芬太尼方案。与依托咪酯相比，氯胺酮诱导后血流动力学不稳定的风险显著更高（风险比1.28 [1.13-1.45]）。然而，与替代对照相比，氯胺酮似乎更优（风险比0.51 [0.29-0.89]）。在死亡率、无呼吸机天数或无ICU天数方面没有差异。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 氯胺酮在插管期间似乎与依托咪酯相比血流动力学稳定性较差，但可能比其他药物表现更好，且对长期结局无影响。

articles.title: 英国老年患者术后谵妄的术后结局：SNAP-3快照观察性研究
articles.originalTitle: Postoperative outcomes in older patients with postoperative delirium in the UK: SNAP-3, a snapshot observational study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Delirium occurs in about 6% of older surgical patients and more frequently in those who are older or frail or undergo urgent surgery. It is associated with adverse postoperative outcomes. However, it remains unclear to what extent delirium is the cause of worse outcomes and to what extent it is a marker of other pre-existing vulnerabilities. METHODS: We conducted a prospective observational cohort study of UK patients aged 60 yr and above undergoing surgery (excluding minor procedures) over 5 days in March 2022. Data were collected on patient characteristics and clinical variables, postoperative delirium, length of stay (LOS) in hospital, morbidity, and mortality. Delirium was assessed on postoperative days 3 and 7 using the four A's Test or Confusion Assessment Method for the Intensive Care Unit tools, supplemented by structured notes review. We analysed the impact of delirium on postoperative outcomes using quantile regression and mixed effects logistic regression, with adjustment for confounding informed by directed acyclic graphs and covariate missing data handled using multiple imputation. RESULTS: Analysis included 7128 patients from 214 hospitals. The incidence of delirium was 6.7% (479/7128). Delirium was associated with longer LOS (increase in median LOS of 5.2 days, effect estimate 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.8-6.5), higher odds of postoperative morbidity (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 10.2; 95% CI, 7.4-13.9), 120-day mortality (aOR, 1.8; 95% CI, 1.2-2.6), and 1-yr mortality (aOR, 2.0; 95% CI, 1.5-2.7). Sensitivity analysis excluding lower-risk daycase patients found similar results to the main analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Delirium, which is common in older people having surgery, negatively impacts on postoperative outcomes and thus must be included in perioperative shared decision-making with patients considering surgical interventions.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 谵妄发生在约6%的老年手术患者中，在年龄更大、体弱或接受紧急手术的患者中更为常见。它与不良术后结局相关。然而，目前尚不清楚谵妄在多大程度上是导致更差结局的原因，以及在多大程度上是其他既有脆弱性的标志。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们进行了一项前瞻性观察性队列研究，研究对象为2022年3月5天内接受手术（不包括小手术）的60岁及以上的英国患者。收集了患者特征和临床变量、术后谵妄、住院时间（LOS）、发病率和死亡率的数据。使用四个A测试或重症监护室混淆评估方法工具在术后第3天和第7天评估谵妄，并辅以结构化笔记审查。我们使用分位数回归和混合效应逻辑回归分析了谵妄对术后结局的影响，并通过有向无环图调整混杂因素，使用多重插补处理协变量缺失数据。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 分析包括来自214家医院的7128名患者。谵妄的发生率为6.7%（479/7128）。谵妄与更长的住院时间（中位住院时间增加5.2天，效应估计95%置信区间[CI]，3.8-6.5）、更高的术后发病率（调整后优势比[aOR]，10.2；95% CI，7.4-13.9）、120天死亡率（aOR，1.8；95% CI，1.2-2.6）和1年死亡率（aOR，2.0；95% CI，1.5-2.7）相关。排除低风险日间手术患者的敏感性分析与主要分析结果相似。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 谵妄在老年手术患者中常见，对术后结局产生负面影响，因此必须纳入考虑手术干预患者的围手术期共同决策中。

articles.question: 术后谵妄在老年手术患者中常见，且与不良预后相关，但既往研究多未能充分区分谵妄的独立效应与患者基础脆弱性的混杂影响。本研究基于大型前瞻性多中心队列，通过校正多种混杂因素，为谵妄对术后结局的独立影响提供了更可靠的证据，强调在围术期决策中应重视谵妄的预防与管理。
articles.conclusion: 在英国老年手术患者中，术后谵妄与更长的住院时间、更高的术后并发症、120天和1年死亡率独立相关，提示谵妄是术后不良结局的重要标志物。
